config.label: Which Base network to serve: "base-mainnet" (default, live since 2026-08-14) or "base-sepolia" for the staging deployment
config.description: Which Base network to serve: "base-mainnet" (default, live since 2026-08-14) or "base-sepolia" for the staging deployment. Every address is baked in; nothing else is required.

config.label: RPC URL override for the selected Base network
config.description: RPC URL override for the selected Base network. Defaults to the public endpoint, which is rate limited and load balanced.

config.label: Raw private key of the agent wallet
config.description: Raw private key of the agent wallet. Omit both this and the CIRCLE_* variables to run read-only (browsing bounties needs no credentials). A worker wallet on Base needs ETH for gas in addition to any USDC.

config.label: Circle Developer-Controlled Wallet API key - alternative to AGENT_PRIVATE_KEY, no raw key in this process
config.description: Circle Developer-Controlled Wallet API key - alternative to AGENT_PRIVATE_KEY, no raw key in this process.
